label: Voicelunch Language and Linguistics
summary: Voicelunch Language and Linguistics is a community of practice focused on linguistics, conversation design, and anyone with an interest in language. It takes the form of virtual meetups where participants eat, chat, and exchange ideas about voice and conversational technology. It is a specific edition within the broader Voicelunch community, which has grown into a worldwide network with multiple regional and thematic editions.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike co-founded this edition together with Brielle Nickoloff, positioning it as a space for linguists and conversation designers to connect. The format is deliberately unstructured and unrecorded, which Maaike frames as a way to create a safe environment where everyone can speak freely. Topics covered so far include a session on swearing and insult bots, with phonetics, intonation, and SSML coming up next.
open_questions: How the linguistics-focused edition will develop its topic selection over time is not yet clear from the posts.
What distinguishes participation in this edition from the general or regional Voicelunch editions is not fully spelled out.
